films.title: My Name Is Nobody
films.overview: Jack Beauregard, an aging gunman of the Old West, only wants to retire in peace and move to Europe, but a young gunfighter known as "Nobody" who idolizes Beauregard wants him to go out in a blaze of glory. So, he arranges for Jack to face the 150-man gang known as The Wild Bunch and earn his place in history.

films.title: A Reason to Live, a Reason to Die
films.overview: A dishonored Union Army officer leads a group of convicts to retake Fort Holman from the Confederate Army.

films.title: Day of Anger
films.overview: A scruffy garbage boy becomes the pupil of famed gunfighter Talby, and the stage for confrontation is set when the gunman overruns the boy's town through violence and corruption.
